prompt: 根據敘述，哪一項必定為真？
text: Every member of the debate club has completed the public-speaking course. Lena has not completed the public-speaking course.
options: Lena is not a member of the debate club.
Lena is a member of the debate club.
Lena dislikes public speaking.
No one has completed the course.
answer: Lena is not a member of the debate club.

若她是成員，就必須完成課程，與敘述矛盾。
敘述沒有提到她的喜好。
敘述說社團成員都完成了課程，所以並非沒人完成。

why: 成員都完成課程；Lena 沒完成，所以不可能是成員。
tip: 若 A 都有 B，沒有 B 的就不是 A。
say: Lena is not a member of the debate club.

prompt: 根據敘述，下列哪一項必定為真？
text: If the museum is open on Monday, then its gift shop is open on Monday. The gift shop is closed this Monday.
options: The museum is closed this Monday.
The museum is open this Monday.
The gift shop is always closed.
The museum has no gift shop.
answer: The museum is closed this Monday.

如果博物館開放，禮品店就必須開放，與禮品店關門矛盾。
敘述只說這個星期一關門。
敘述已經說明有禮品店。

why: 若開放則禮品店開放；禮品店沒開，所以博物館必定沒開（逆否命題）。
tip: 若 P 則 Q；沒有 Q，就一定沒有 P。
say: The museum is closed this Monday.

prompt: 根據敘述，哪一項推論最安全？
text: In a survey of 200 commuters, 120 said they use the train, and 90 said they use the bus. Everyone surveyed uses at least one of the two.
options: At least 10 commuters use both the train and the bus.
No commuter uses both.
Exactly 60 commuters use both.
More commuters use the bus than the train.
answer: At least 10 commuters use both the train and the bus.

120+90=210 超過 200 人，必然有人重複，所以不可能沒有人兩者都用。
只能確定至少 10 人，無法確定恰好 60 人。
wrong.More commuters use the bus than the trai: 120 大於 90，說明搭火車的人較多。

tip: 總和超過人數，差額就是至少重疊數。
say: At least ten commuters use both.

prompt: 根據敘述，下列哪一項最能由此推出？
text: Last year, the average price of homes in Greenfield was higher than the average price in Millbrook. This year, home prices rose in both towns by the same percentage.
options: 今年 Greenfield 的平均房價仍高於 Millbrook
今年 Millbrook 的平均房價高於 Greenfield
今年兩地房價相同
房價每年都上漲
answer: 今年 Greenfield 的平均房價仍高於 Millbrook

wrong.今年 Millbrook 的平均房價高於 Greenfield: 同樣百分比的上漲不會改變原本的高低順序。
wrong.今年兩地房價相同: 兩地原本不同，同比例上漲後仍不同。
wrong.房價每年都上漲: 只提到今年上漲，沒有談其他年份。

why: 較高的數乘上同樣的倍數仍然較高，順序不變。
tip: 同比例變化不會改變誰大誰小。

prompt: 根據敘述，哪一項不能被推出？
text: All the flights from the airport's Terminal B go to Asia. Some flights from Terminal B depart before noon.
options: All flights departing before noon go to Asia.
Some flights to Asia depart before noon.
Terminal B has flights.
Some flights from the airport go to Asia.
answer: All flights departing before noon go to Asia.

B 航站的部分早班機飛亞洲，所以可以推出。
敘述直接說明 B 航站有航班。
wrong.Some flights from the airport go to Asia: B 航站所有航班飛亞洲，因此機場的確有飛亞洲的航班。

why: 敘述只說明 B 航站的航班，沒有說明其他航站的早班機也飛亞洲，所以不能推出所有。
tip: 「有些」的範圍不能擴大成「全部」。

prompt: 規定：「所有會員都要在入場時出示卡片。」你看到某人沒出示卡片就進去了。哪一個結論最安全？
options: That person either is not a member or broke the rule.
That person is definitely a member.
The rule is false.
No one shows a card.
answer: That person either is not a member or broke the rule.

沒有證據證明他是會員。
一個人違規不代表規定錯誤。
只觀察到一個人沒出示，無法推到所有人。

why: 規定只針對會員；沒出示卡片的人若是會員就違規，否則可能不是會員。
tip: 規定被打破，有兩種可能：不是對象，或違規。
say: That person either is not a member or broke the rule.

prompt: 根據敘述，下列哪一項推論有問題？
text: A gym's membership rose 25 percent this year. Its total revenue also rose.
options: Each member must be paying more per month.
Revenue may have risen because there are more members.
The gym has more members than last year.
Revenue growth is not necessarily 25 percent.
answer: Each member must be paying more per month.

wrong.Revenue may have risen because there are: 會員增加確實可能是營收增加的原因，推論合理。
會員成長 25%，所以人數更多，是正確推論。
wrong.Revenue growth is not necessarily 25 per: 營收還受價格等因素影響，不一定是 25%，這是合理的。

why: 營收上升可以僅因人數增加，不一定是每位會員付更多錢，所以「必定」過強。
tip: 小心 must 這類過強的推論用語。
